scope: Independent HEVC sample-code qualification and chromatic PQ/HLG primary conversion, plus four-file Metal RAM/swap transport. Full goal remains open.

independent_sample_evidence.independent_decoder: ffmpeg version 9.0.2 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
independent_sample_evidence.normalization_note: FFmpeg grayscale RGBA16 uses left shift; RGB uses full-range scaling. Compare recovered 12-bit codes, not their distinct u16 expansion.

color_oracle: Existing 60-digit Decimal transfer and exact Fraction chromaticity-derived BT.2020-to-sRGB matrix in scripts/generate-pq-color-oracle.py; no production coefficients imported.
color_oracle_scope: All pixels of pure red/green/blue bands compared at white=100, HLG peak=1000 gamma=1.2, relative tolerance 2e-6 (minimum absolute tolerance 2e-6). Mixed band checked at native-code and transport levels, not independently at linear-conversion level.
metal: Apple M4 Max; four files (gray/color PQ/HLG), exact float component bits and SDR/HDR pre/post swap, negative out-of-gamut values retained, memory pressure retry and final release.
initial_generator_refinement: FFmpeg expands grayscale with left shift while RGB uses full-range u16 normalization. All four sources are compared as recovered 12-bit codes; not falsely claimed byte-identical u16 normalization.
limitations: Independent FFmpeg decoding of synthetic lossless HEVC controls; independent photographic/camera producers remain unqualified.
Opaque RGB only; HDR alpha, sequence, other HEIF codecs and wide producer metadata remain open.
Offscreen Metal readback does not qualify physical HDR brightness/color. NVIDIA remains deferred.
